{{Quote|Tagta, it is ''vital'' that the Republic secure this trade route. We are prepared to ''negotiate'' the terms of your co-operation.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to [[Tagta]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]|<ref name="The Guns of Nar Hekka" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] undertook a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nar Hekka]], the origins of disturbances to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] matériel being shipped along the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Sheela Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].
